title: The Real OTA Commission Isn't 15%. It's Up to 30%.
hook_line: The real commission runs 18 to 30 percent. That's well above the 15 to 25 headline rate hotels think they're paying.
cliffhanger_line: So the commission doesn't just cost money. It buys you a less reliable booking too.

why: Opens on the headline stat (63.4% loss, cancellation gap) and the $135K arithmetic, then cuts before naming the fix (the agent stack) — keeps viewers wanting the resolution only the long-form has.
